effects.instruction: Narrator only, today's plan (do not foreshadow anything beyond it): the day of the League's attack on U.A.: this morning Tomura Shigaraki and Kurogiri brief the hired crew at the League Hideout Bar with the U.A. timetable stolen in the gate break-in (All Might teaches Class 1-A at the USJ this afternoon); after lunch Kurogiri's gate takes them to the USJ. No other job today.
